top_signals.title: Chevron to Invest $7 Billion to Boost Venezuelan Output
top_signals.summary: Chevron plans to more than double its oil production in Venezuela, investing $7 billion over the next five years. The company is making largest financial commitment so far in a US government-led push to revive the Latin American country’s industry. Tyler Kendall reports on Bloomberg Television. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Berkshire CEO Greg Abel says Japanese bond yields not a challenge for trading houses right now
top_signals.summary: In an appearance on CNBC's "Squawk Box," Greg Abel said that yields in the country are still relatively low.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
